2. What will be its height if kerosene is used to make a barometer instead of mercury?
(Density of kerosene is $0.8\text{ gm/cc}$)

3. A crown of gold and an equal weight of pure gold are hung from the two sides of a bar and then immersed into water (Figure 5.15). If we find that in water the weight of the crown is less, then what will you say about the crown? Is it pure or impure? Why?

4. Two water filled cylinders are connected by a pipe. The cross sectional area of the two cylinders are $1\text{ cm}^2$ and $1\text{ m}^2$ and two pistons are attached with them. A person of weight $70\text{ kg}$ is sitting on the bigger piston. How much force will you have to apply on the smaller piston if you want to lift him?

5. A weight of $10\text{ kg}$ is hung from a metal rod of $0.5\text{ m}$ length and $0.01\text{ m}^2$ cross sectional area. The elongated length is $0.501\text{ m}$. What is the Young's modulus of this metal rod?
